summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K regarding a lease agreement for industrial space in Yuma, Arizona. The lease covers two buildings totaling ~54,400 sq ft with a five-year and four-year-seven-month term. Base rent ranges from $7,810.25 to $30,596.39 monthly, with a rent abatement period. The company also has an option to purchase the premises for $4.5M, increasing 3% annually. This is a routine operational agreement, not a special situation. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
